LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 2.1: Places of Worship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Places of Worship. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where do we go to pray?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate appropriate behaviour in a place of different places of worship worship.
2. appreciate a place of worship as holy. 2.2 Basic postures for worship (3 lessons)
3. appreciate the places of worship. worship as well as for good health.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate appropriate behaviour in a place of different places of worship worship.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate appropriate behaviour in a place of different places of worship worship. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate a place of worship as holy. 2.2 Basic postures for worship (3 lessons)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate a place of worship as holy. 2.2 Basic postures for worship (3 lessons). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the places of worship. worship as well as for good health.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the places of worship. worship as well as for good health. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Places of Worship.
2. Explain Places of Worship to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Places of Worship.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate appropriate behaviour in a place of different places of worship worship.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Places of Worship. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Where do we go to pray?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate appropriate behaviour in a place of different places of worship worship.
2. appreciate a place of worship as holy. 2.2 Basic postures for worship (3 lessons)
3. appreciate the places of worship. worship as well as for good health.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
